deadlines.label: Rolling; awards made at CWCB's six Board meetings a year until all program funds are obligated
deadlines.quote: Applications to the TAFC program will be accepted on a rolling basis, with awards made to coincide with CWCB's annual schedule of Board meetings (six times per year). Applications will be accepted until all Program funds are obligated.

match.appliesTo: All TAFC grants; no more than half of the match (12.5 percent) may be in-kind services
match.quote: A minimum of 25 percent match is required for all TAFC Grants.

sections.name: Scope of work
sections.quote: All grant applications must include a scope of work, budget, and project schedule.

criteria.name: Furthers Colorado Water Plan or Basin Implementation Plan goals (priority to basin roundtable-identified or collaborative watershed planning projects)
criteria.quote: Does the project further Colorado Water Plan or current Basin Implementation Plan goals, objectives, or actions?

criteria.name: Advances interstate, regional or watershed-scale water and natural resource management
criteria.quote: Does the project advance interstate, regional or watershed-scale water and natural resource management efforts and solutions?

criteria.name: Local community and diverse stakeholder support, with input from relevant government agencies
criteria.quote: Does the project have local community and diverse stakeholder support? Have relevant federal, state and local government agencies provided input on the project?

other: Application forms are on the CWCB Loan and Grant Portal on the CWCB website
format.quote: Application forms are available on the CWCB Loan and Grant Portal on the CWCB website

eligibility.item: Eligible applicants: governmental entities (municipalities, districts, enterprises, counties) and private entities (mutual ditch companies, non-profit corporations, partnerships)
eligibility.quote: Governmental entities including municipalities, districts, enterprises, and counties.

eligibility.item: State of Colorado agencies are generally not eligible, except in limited circumstances at program staff discretion
eligibility.quote: State of Colorado agencies are generally not eligible applicants, although program staff have discretion to allow state agencies to apply in certain limited circumstances.

eligibility.item: Covered Entities (Section 37-60-126, C.R.S.) are eligible only if they have adopted an approved water conservation plan
eligibility.quote: Covered Entities as defined in Section 37-60-126, C.R.S., are eligible if the applicant has adopted an approved water conservation plan.

eligibility.item: Provide at least a 25 percent match
eligibility.quote: A minimum of 25 percent match is required for all TAFC Grants.

eligibility.item: No more than half (12.5 percent) of the total match may be in-kind services
eligibility.quote: no more than half (12.5 percent) of total match may be in the form of in-kind services.

eligibility.item: Contact the CWCB to discuss the potential project before applying
eligibility.quote: Prior to submitting an application, interested parties must contact the CWCB to discuss potential projects.

eligibility.item: Every TAFC grant must include preparing and submitting at least one federal grant application as a discrete task in its scope and budget
eligibility.quote: All TAFC grants awarded must include the preparation and submission of at least one federal grant application as a discrete task within the grant's scope and budget.

requiredDocuments.item: Application form through the CWCB Loan and Grant Portal
requiredDocuments.quote: Application forms are available on the CWCB Loan and Grant Portal on the CWCB website
All grant applications must include a scope of work, budget, and project schedule.
All grant applications must include a scope of work, budget, and project schedule.

requiredDocuments.item: At contracting: Insurance Certificate of Liability (some government entities excluded)
requiredDocuments.quote: Required contracting documents include, but are not limited to, the following: Insurance Certificate of Liability (some government entities excluded)

requiredDocuments.item: At contracting: Electronic Funds Transfer authorization (preferred) or a current mailing address
requiredDocuments.quote: Electronic Funds Transfer authorization (preferred) or a current mailing address (in the event that a paper check is issued)

requiredDocuments.item: At contracting: demonstration of an active federal Unique Entity Identifier (UEI)
requiredDocuments.quote: Demonstration of an active federal Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), so that CWCB can confirm an applicant's eligibility to receive federal funding
